what: r13e-s4: the owner's s4 key stream as Resyst VK 0.11.0 received it, decoded by scripts/r13e_s4_decode.py from the raw touches (VK's hit cells, slides, long-press variants, space flick/drag, held-⌫ repeats). One entry per message, ended by the Enter that sent it. t = ms since the session's first key. r13f: space-bar gestures decoded with --gestures r13f-intent (see the script's GESTURES).
